note: Work package 36 requirement 1: the nucleus reclassified under the resident-service model. Every kernel object linked into the two-bank measurement build (the package-35 resident-service spike, transport A) and the package-35 substrate is assigned exactly one tier. Object sizes are measured from the build's .rel files by tools/rev13_layout.py; the M10 mechanisms stage 6 implements are carried as tagged estimates (they are not linked into the spike build). Measurement only: the tier assignment is a design statement, not a migration.

tiers.fixed: must be visible while the window shows the service bank: gates, IPC dispatch, the copy primitive, service-callable nucleus primitives, the IRQ executive, any nucleus code that calls a service, and the data those touch. Placed in the 2000h-5FFFh fixed region at the 6000h split.
tiers.cold: nucleus code and data used only with P = 0 (syscall-side bookkeeping, xmem allocation, boot-only setup, panic formatting). Placed in bank 7's window half.
tiers.service: moves to the service bank (bank 6): VFS core, ROMFS provider, drivers, the console composition.
tiers.retired: replaced in the service model and not counted anywhere.

stacks.name: isr
stacks.reason: the IRQ executive runs with whatever mapping is active, so the relocated ISR stack lives in the fixed region (2000h-5FFFh at the 6000h split), not in common

stacks.name: service
stacks.reason: the service stack is switched to by the fixed rsvc_invoke primitive while the service bank is mapped, so it lives in the fixed region, not in common (package 35 pinned 512 bytes: the deepest measured chain used 278 of 384, which was a common-ceiling artefact)

estimates.reason: unified bank ownership (the process bank map extended to FREE/PRIMARY/AUXILIARY): the window service resolves its own bank through it while the service bank is mapped, so it is fixed
ZEX v2 loader net increase over v1; the loader is the executable-stream upcall, so the delta is fixed
SYS_XMEM_* family and allocator: syscall-side, entered with P = 0; services use descriptors and nucleus copies instead

sio.reason: UART bring-up and module registration are boot-only; putc/write/poll/getc and the port primitives are runtime

hid.reason: driver bring-up and registration are boot-only; hid_fetch/service/read_text/poll/getc are runtime

ioc.reason: port setup, link bring-up (probing) and registration are boot-only; command/bulk/status operations and the port primitives are runtime.  _ioc_io_bulk_init is the asm bulk-engine bring-up, measured from the module link map

v9958.reason: VDP bring-up, palette/G6 setup and the ROMFS font/atlas upload are boot-only (the WORK.md example).  Caveat, recorded in the report: v9958_init_display and its upload chain are also reachable from a runtime display reset (ESC c / RIS / ZVIDEO_RESET); the tier treats them as boot-bring-up code, and a production design must either keep that path reachable or reload through the boot loader

iocfat.reason: CAPS negotiation, mount and provider registration are boot-only (the WORK.md example); open/read/write/readdir/rename and the cache/transfer engine are runtime

service_vfs.nucleus_primitive_note: the ROMFS reader stays in the nucleus as the bootstrap-reader primitive (measured size from the build); the provider service calls it through the fixed region
